neutralControl.purpose: Same menu and race-start prefix through 22820, then no further input. All capture files through 24400 match the driven run; later acceleration observations are reviewed visually.

copperstart-preflight: Loading at 800/1600, Fairlight / Crack Inc intro at 2800; Return at 3500 exits it
Disk-two prompt at 4800/6400; disk swap 5000/5100, first fire press 6500 passes
Magnetic Fields at 7200, road at 8000, Lotus III title at 9600
Interactive options at 11200/12000; car selection at 14400/15600/16800
native-preflight: Same Fairlight / Crack Inc intro at 2800; disk-two prompt at 4800 through 9600
Third fire press at 10500 passes the prompt; Magnetic Fields at 11200, road at 12000
Driving demo at 14400, high scores at 15600, title at 16800
copperstart-race: Car selection at 18400; fire 18800 confirms car, music selection visible 19200/20400
Fire 20800 confirms music; race-one information at 21200/22400
Opening race at 22800/23600; coasting at 24400 before held fire 24800
89 KPH and score 63770 at 25200; course scenery and position advance at 25600
Time expires by 26400; player score at 26800; automatic driving demo at 30000 and title at 32000
Directional events at 26800/28000 are after time-up; steering response is not qualified
copperstart-no-acceleration: Same menu and race-start confirmations through 22820; all capture files through 24400 match the driven run
At 25200 the released-input control is coasting at a lower speed with zero score, while the driven run displays 089 KPH and score 63770; reviewed enlarged HUD comparison
This distinguishes accelerator response from automatic demo playback; steering and race completion remain unverified
native-race: Options at 20400; car selection at 22400; music selection at 24800
Race-one information at 25600; opening race at 26800/28000
Driving and turning-zone scenery at 30000; black 32000 follows time expiration, not an execution stop

classification: Raw replay manifests remain unreviewed automation output; human visual review and the bounded result are recorded here and in the companion Markdown.
nativeControlLimits: Original-ROM startup changes the phase of the narrow polling loop. Same-script milestone timings and final state are not expected to match CopperStart. Historical engine/CPU timing evidence uses different binaries and is not relabeled.
scope: Bounded menu and opening-race input response only. No race completion, complete-game progression, audio listening/fidelity, cycle correctness, hardware or host throughput acceptance claim. PCM parity covers captured fields, not an entire continuous soundtrack.
validation: No production or test source changes; no new build or emulator unit-suite pass claimed. This record adds the new title replay to the exact preceding qualified ROM. Prior test/build results are provenance, not newly executed tests.
overlap: The 18000-field and 32000-field scripts share the early sequence; do not sum them as independent unique gameplay coverage.
excludedAttempt: An early neutral-input probe stopped after car selection at 18820, before the subsequent music and race confirmations. It was intentionally terminated, is incomplete and is excluded from pass counts and comparisons. The final control includes all confirmations through 22820.
